query:
SELECT 
  SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)) as total_cat1,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat2,0)) as total_cat2,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat3,0)) as total_cat3,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat4,0)) as total_cat4,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat5,0)) as total_cat5,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat6,0)) as total_cat6,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat7,0)) as total_cat7,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat8,0)) as total_cat8,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat9,0)) as total_cat9,
  SUM(COALESCE(cat1,0)+COALESCE(cat2,0)+COALESCE(cat3,0)+COALESCE(cat4,0)+COALESCE(cat5,0)+COALESCE(cat6,0)+COALESCE(cat7,0)+COALESCE(cat8,0)+COALESCE(cat9,0)) as total_geral,
  COUNT(*) as dias_lancados,
  SUM(CASE WHEN data <= '2026-03-27' THEN COALESCE(cat1,0)+COALESCE(cat2,0)+COALESCE(cat3,0)+COALESCE(cat4,0)+COALESCE(cat5,0)+COALESCE(cat6,0)+COALESCE(cat7,0)+COALESCE(cat8,0)+COALESCE(cat9,0) ELSE 0 END) as total_realizado
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND data LIKE '2026-03-%';
